default.title: Menus and ecommerce
default.text: Embedded, hybrid, or fully headless. We match the menu build to how you actually sell, then make the cart survive a phone on a bad connection.

default.title: POS and inventory
default.text: One source of truth. Product names, prices, and potency come from the register, not a spreadsheet someone forgot to update.

default.title: Loyalty and retention
default.text: The list is the asset. Sign ups on the site drop straight into the program, with segments that match how people buy.

default.title: Marketing and analytics
default.text: Attribution that holds up when someone asks which channel paid for itself last month.

default.title: Compliance and access
default.text: Age gates, disclaimers, and state rules handled per market so legal stops chasing you.
